content:
zhen: Heads-up — while profiling a long-context job today I noticed repeated slot handoff spikes that line up with stepwise memory growth. Put together a short log snippet and a flame sample. :eyes:

zhen: logs sample:
```
2026-02-18T14:22:03Z INFO slot_handoff from_slab=3 to_slab=4 slot_id=0x7f latency_ms=28 ctx_len=16384 node=run-14
2026-02-18T14:22:05Z INFO slot_handoff from_slab=4 to_slab=5 slot_id=0x9a latency_ms=52 ctx_len=32768 node=run-14
2026-02-18T14:22:07Z INFO slot_handoff from_slab=5 to_slab=6 slot_id=0x9a latency_ms=47 ctx_len=65536 node=run-14
```

zhen: flame sample attached (short): handoff path -> copy_mempages -> compact_slab -> free_scan. Seems like the handoff copies pages and triggers a short stop-the-world compaction for the source slab, which explains the stepwise RSS increase.

matt: interesting. do we already emit a metric for handoffs? i remember a kv.handoff_total counter but not sure what labels it has. can you link the trace id?

zhen: trace id t-0a1b2c3d attached from perf-bot. perf-bot: trace t-0a1b2c3d stored at https://perf.redwood/trace/t-0a1b2c3d :wave:

perf-bot: profile snapshot 2026-02-18T14:22:10 uploaded (id=ps-789).

sara: we do have kv_handoff_total in prometheus but it's only labeled by node and op_type. not by from_slab/to_slab or ctx_len. that makes heatmaps impossible.

kevin: proposal: add labels: from_slab, to_slab, ctx_len_bucket and a histogram kv_handoff_latency_ms. then we can do queries like:
```
increase(kv_handoff_total{node=~"run-.*"}[5m])
sum(rate(kv_handoff_latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le, from_slab, to_slab)
```
This will let us produce a slab transition heatmap and percentile latency per transition.

asha: agree. also expose a gauge kv_handoff_in_progress with labels to correlate concurrent handoffs with GC/paging. alert suggestions:
- if increase(kv_handoff_total[1m]) per node > 50 and avg latency > 40ms -> P2
- if kv_handoff_in_progress > 3 for > 30s -> P1 (could indicate stuck handoff) :rotating_light:

matt: dashboards: 1) stacked bar of handoffs by from_slab over time, 2) origin->dest heatmap, 3) handoff latency p50/p95 per slab pair, 4) annotation lane showing GC/paging events and OOM pauses. adding a panel for memory step deltas aligned to handoff times is useful. :bar_chart:

zhen: quick prometheus example to compute per-slab-pair p95 (approx using histogram):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(kv_handoff_latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le, from_slab, to_slab))
```

sara: note: ctx_len_bucket label cardinality worry. suggest bucketing into [<=8k, <=32k, <=128k, >128k] to keep series bounded. also limit slab id to a small int (we already have numbered slabs).

kevin: implementation notes: emitting labels at handoff site is cheap, but avoid high-cardinality tags from model-id or prompt-id. include an occasional sampling mode where we emit full context_id for 1/1000 requests for tracing.

zhen: small action list:
- kevin: add metrics + histogram + in_progress gauge (PR)
- sara: add grafana dashboard panels + heatmap template
- matt: add alert rules prototype
- asha: define SLO/thresholds for handoff-heavy services

zhen: i'll open a short RFC PR and tag eng-runtime and perf to review. assigning initial patch to @kevin. thanks all. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: RFC created: https://git.redwood/r/redwood/infra/-/merge_requests/5123 (kv handoff metrics)

matt: digging into the trace now — will post any surprising correlations.

zhen: leaving this thread open for follow-ups, will post PR link when ready.
